findings.title: Lithuanian TOTP instructions replaced with Italian text
findings.description: `loginTotpStep1` now reads `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian. The same change is in `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_lt.properties:101` (`totpStep1`). Both previously held Lithuanian text. Lithuanian users will see Italian on the login TOTP setup page and in the account console. The verifier accepts this because it is valid HTML. Restore a Lithuanian translation in both files.

findings.title: Simplified zh_CN account string written in Traditional Chinese
findings.description: `totpStep1=在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` uses Traditional characters (手機, 安裝, 應用程式). The rest of the Simplified file does not, and the zh_CN login file at line 123 uses Simplified (`在您的移动设备中安装以下任意一个应用：`). Use the Simplified form, for example `在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：`.

findings.title: ICU choice syntax in shared English strings is likely to render raw in the JS consoles
findings.description:
The English `error-invalid-multivalued-size` now ends in `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`. The same change is in the admin-ui English file (line 3138), the login English file (`themes/src/main/resources/theme/base/login/messages/messages_en.properties:530`), and the admin theme English file (line 69). Server-side `MessageFormat` handles this correctly, and the validator passes `Long` arguments (`services/.../MultiValueValidator.java:136-137`), so the Java paths are fine.

The JS consoles are different. Both use plain i18next with `{{ }}` interpolation and no ICU plugin (`js/apps/account-ui/src/i18n.ts:25-47`, `js/apps/admin-ui/src/i18n/i18n.ts:13-37`). The account REST error path sends the raw key and params (`services/.../account/AccountRestService.java:168-171`), and the client translates them with `t(key, params)` (`js/libs/ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:74-86`). The server-side conversion in `AccountConsole.java:75,319-336` only rewrites `{N}` placeholders. The choice token will probably appear as literal text. I did not run the UI to confirm. Either keep the JS-bundled wording plain (`value(s)`) or add ICU support to the JS apps.

findings.title: Verifier throws RuntimeException on a missing or unreadable English file, aborting the whole run
findings.description: `verify()` converts I/O failures into `MojoExecutionException`, but `verifySafeHtml()` throws `RuntimeException` at lines 70 and 79. `ThemeVerifierMojo.execute()` (line 51) does not catch it, so one file without an `_en` counterpart stops the entire run with a stack trace and no collected messages. `verifySafeHtml()` also re-opens the file (lines 67-68) even though `verify()` already holds `contents` (line 49). Record a message in `messages` instead of throwing, and build the bundle from `contents` with `new PropertyResourceBundle(new StringReader(contents))`.

findings.title: English counterpart derived by regex over the full absolute path
findings.description: `file.getAbsolutePath().replaceAll("resources-community", "resources")` replaces every occurrence in the whole path, so a checkout directory containing that string points at the wrong English file. The unanchored `_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties` pattern rewrites any matching `_xxx.properties` substring. A base name with an underscore and no locale suffix is mis-derived. The fixture rename from `duplicate_keys.properties` to `duplicateKeys_en.properties` (test line 32) is a symptom of this. Line 132 (`file.getAbsolutePath().contains("email")`) is a similar path heuristic that matches any directory named like "email". Derive the English path from the file name and parent directory only, using an anchored locale pattern.

findings.title: ANCHOR_PATTERN matches any tag beginning with "a"
findings.description: `</?a[^>]*>` matches `<abbr>`, `<address>`, `<article>`, `<audio>`, and similar tags. Those tags are reported as "Didn't find anchor tag" when absent from English, and when they match English they are stripped before sanitizing, so the allowlist does not apply to them. Use `</?a\b[^>]*>` and add a test with an `<abbr>` tag.

findings.title: Tests cover only failure paths, and one assertion was weakened
findings.description:
`verifyDuplicateKeysDetected` changed from `Matchers.contains(...)` (exactly one message) to `Matchers.hasItem(...)`, which accepts any extra messages. None of the new tests cover the passing path. Nothing checks that a valid translation produces no messages, that `
`, `

`, or `` are accepted when the English contains HTML, that matching anchors pass, that `{n,choice}` is normalized, or that a missing English counterpart is handled. Add a clean-translation fixture asserting `empty()`, and a matching-anchor fixture.

findings.title: commons-text pinned to 1.13.0 in a new dependency
findings.description: My understanding is that Apache fixed an uncontrolled recursion issue (CVE-2025-48924) in 1.14.0, which would make 1.13.0 affected. I did not check the advisory from this environment. The code only calls `StringEscapeUtils.unescapeHtml4`, so exposure is probably low, but a new dependency should not be added at a version with a known issue. Bump to 1.14.0 or later, or drop the single call, and run the project's dependency scanner.

findings.title: Sanitizer version duplicated, redundant compile scope
findings.description: The module hard-codes `owasp-java-html-sanitizer` 20240325.1, the same value as the root property `owasp.html.sanitizer.version` (root `pom.xml:119`). The module has no parent, so it cannot inherit that property, but the two can drift. `<scope>compile</scope>` on `commons-text` (line 84) is the default and can be removed.

findings.title: Field visibility, naming, and typos in the verifier
findings.description: `POLICY_SOME_HTML` and `POLICY_NO_HTML` are package-private, non-static, non-final fields, rebuilt for every file. `HTML_TAGS` (line 139) has the same problem, while `ANCHOR_PATTERN` (line 145) is `private static final`. Make all three `private static final`. Rename `santizeAnchors` (line 150) to `sanitizeAnchors`, and fix "numberic" in the comment on line 94.

findings.title: Nine translation strings across six locales drop their download links
findings.description: The `totpStep1` and `loginTotpStep1` strings in fi, lt, no, sk, sv, and zh_CN no longer contain FreeOTP, Google Play, or App Store links. The English source has no links (`themes/src/main/resources/theme/base/account/messages/messages_en.properties:150`), and the anchor check only allows anchors present in English, so removing them is consistent with the verifier. It is still a content change beyond the verifier fix, so confirm it is intended.

findings.title: Sanitizer ordering blocks the obvious bypasses
findings.description: Anchor stripping runs before the sanitizer, so tags created by removing a matched anchor (for example `<<a>script>`) are still seen by the sanitizer. Entities are unescaped before comparison, so an escaped `<script>` in a translation is flagged. I found no bypass in the comparison logic. Keep this ordering when editing.
